units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:23">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>שאני פוֹסֵחַ עליכם ומגין וכ׳</he> I (the Lord) will pass over and protect you.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:5">Pes. X, 5</cite> <he>פֶּסַח על שום שפ׳ המקום וכ׳</he> the Passover lamb is symbolical of the fact that the Lord passed over the houses &c.

senses.gloss: (denom. of פִּסֵּחַ) to become lame. Y. Ber. I, 3ᶜ bot. ונ׳ ונתרפא and became lame, but was cured; Gen. R. s. 39; a. e.
